source: QuantLib EquityOption example, European case; flat curves referenced to 17 May 1998 and maturity 17 May 1999 (Actual/365 Fixed).
quote_status: Illustrative bid and ask for the same European put at time zero, not observed market quotes.

simulation.settlement: Cash payment of max(strike minus terminal spot, zero). Hypothetical contract on a tradable, non-dividend-paying asset.
simulation.funding: Continuous 6% lending and borrowing; shorting allowed with no additional stock-borrow fee; no margin constraints.
